governanceRationaleClarifications.issue: The rationale says the source does not establish the pilot intermediate assembly classification, so it is not inherited. This is acceptable as a refusal to auto-inherit a prior proposal, but absence of literal source taxonomy is not evidence that an intermediate assembly node is semantically invalid or that the taxonomy must be flatter.

Explicitly leave any assembly intermediate for review of its local definition, broader/narrower relation and inherited topic warrant; do not auto-restore or auto-approve it, and do not reject it solely because source prose omits taxonomy labels.
governanceRationaleClarifications.reviewLimit: The prior tasks metadata was outside this cross-review, so no exact prior assembly edge or semantic validity is asserted here.
governanceRationaleClarifications.status: governance clarification only; author artifact unchanged

outstandingGovernance: Null source-kind/lifecycle mappings remain semantic draft gaps pending explicitly declared record verification and kind decisions. They are not an executable lifecycle enum.
Quoted source IDs and inventory attributions are not runtime allocation evidence; proposal records need the actual governed proposal identity path before any materialization.

Effective scopes, scopeComponents, and scoped supersession are semantic proposals. A real applicability representation must preserve VIP exclusions and independent claim scope rather than flatten them into whole-record status.

The flat policy vocabulary is explicit source context. Manufacturing hierarchy is a curator proposal; broader/narrower relations and meanings such as tolerances under operating-pressure need local definitions and governance, not literal taxonomy sentences in source documents.
Accepted fixture curation may later review source-derived metadata or declare an empty recorded set, but no such approval is created here and explicitly missing classification must remain absent.
conclusion: Acceptable as a reviewable semantic draft with C1 requested before freeze and G1 clarifying taxonomy rationale. All 28 attributions agree; no lifecycle, VIP precedence, missing-classification, or independent-page warrant correction was found. This cross-review is not governance-owner approval, executable applicability/schema validation, runtime allocation/testing, or a source/judgment change.
